answer: Admission locks 30 POA per identity, refunded slowly over 12 epochs and forfeited on any grading conviction. A farm of 140 aliases must park 4200 POA it cannot touch, so the attack pays rent on its own fraud while honest agents pay nothing in the end. The relic is the check that cannot be faked, the delta is the price the attacker pays, and the karst is the record that outlives the epoch.
